How the calculator handles bonus points

  • Exams, labs, and PAs may include points above their maximum, but each category is capped at its course weight.
  • PA bonus points are pooled to cover points missing from the 50% minimum on another PA. PA0 needs 12.5 of 25 points; PA1–PA3 need 50 of 100.
  • Grades stay in this browser only. Nothing is submitted or sent to your professor.
